system: You are a security investigator reviewing an alert. Base every claim only on the evidence available to you. Cite the record IDs that support each observation.

supporting_observations.claim: At 13:45:58 UTC, WS-ICHEN-01 sent 51,000,389 bytes to the explicit proxy at 10.40.20.30:8080 over a roughly 9-second HTTP connection; the connection record shows only 9,017 response bytes.
The flow record establishes a large client-to-proxy transfer, but does not identify the external destination, the data transferred, or the process that sent it.

After the main transfer, proxy records show ivy.chen using Chrome to access aws.amazon.com and AWS static resources, including the AWS console. This later browsing does not establish that the large transfer was to AWS or related to that browsing.

known_telemetry_limitations: Sensor coverage metadata reports a collection outage from 13:30 to 14:10 UTC for WS-ICHEN-01 winsec and Sysmon, and for the proxy sensor. The large transfer occurred within that interval; the coverage metadata does not provide record IDs.
Zeek connection and DNS sensors are reported as available, but the provided flow record does not reveal the proxied external destination or transfer contents (T039-00140).
claims_not_established: Whether the transfer reached an external destination, and if so, which destination.
Whether the bytes were a file upload, what data they contained, or whether the transfer was authorized.
Which process or user action initiated the transfer, or whether it was connected to the later AWS console browsing.
Whether the transfer was malicious exfiltration or a legitimate activity.
additional_evidence_needed: Recover or obtain proxy records for 13:45–13:46 UTC, including the destination, URL or CONNECT host, authenticated user, request method, and byte counts.
Obtain endpoint EDR or other process-level network telemetry for WS-ICHEN-01 around 13:46 UTC, plus relevant file-access, browser, and upload artifacts.
Check DLP, file classification, and network egress records to determine what data was transferred and whether it was approved.
Validate with ivy.chen and relevant service or application owners whether a large upload was expected at that time.
